import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MODX1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MODX2 = 1000000007L;
    static final long[] powx = {1L, 10L, 100L, 1000L, 10000L, 100000L, 1000000L};
    static long[] prefixSum = new long[7];
    static long totalAnswer = 0;
    static long counterX1 = 0;
    static long maxNumber;
    static long counterX2 = 0;
    static List<Long>[] digitLists = new ArrayList[7];

    public static void generateSequences(int level, long val) {
        if (level == 7) return;
        long modVal = (counterX1 - val + MODX1) % MODX1;
        digitLists[level].add(modVal);
        prefixSum[level] += modVal;
        counterX1++;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            generateSequences(level + 1, val * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    public static boolean inValidRange(long x) {
        return x * powx[6] + 999999 <= maxNumber && x * powx[6] * 10 > maxNumber;
    }

    public static void traverse(int level, long current) {
        if (current > maxNumber) return;
        if (inValidRange(current)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long p = ((counterX2 + 1 - (current * powx[i]) % MODX1) + MODX1) % MODX1;
                List<Long> list = digitLists[i];
                int pos = lowerBound(list, MODX1 - p);
                long size = list.size();
                long sumPart = prefixSum[i] + p * size - MODX1 * (size - pos);
                totalAnswer = (totalAnswer + sumPart) % MODX2;
            }
            counterX2 += counterX1;
            return;
        }
        counterX2++;
        totalAnswer = (totalAnswer + ((counterX2 - current) % MODX1 + MODX1) % MODX1) % MODX2;
        int startD = (level == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int d = startD; d <= 9; d++) {
            traverse(level + 1, current * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    public static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        maxNumber = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            digitLists[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        generateSequences(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digitLists[i]);
        }
        counterX2 = -1;
        traverse(0, 0);
        System.out.println(totalAnswer);
    }
}
